is one step of the seminar. It ends with a **Do it** task and one set of
questions. The full explanations, examples and exercises are in the notes.

## Key terms

{{< glossary baas cloud-save leaderboard object-storage cdn dedicated-server cloud-region data-egress pay-as-you-go >}}

## 22.1 The services of an online game

- **BaaS:** accounts, **cloud saves**, **leaderboards**.
- **Object storage + CDN:** level packs, art, videos.
- **Dedicated servers:** live matches, in regions.
- **Analytics:** crashes and sessions.

![The cloud services of Pocket Quest.](images/game-cloud.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Building everything yourself on a VM is rarely cheaper for a small studio.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · A map of services"}
Draw the cloud map of a mobile game you know, with at least three services.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · The services"}
Choose the service.

::: {.match extra="a USB stick|the screen"}
level 12 and 840 coins on a new phone
:   cloud save

the best race times of all players
:   leaderboard

an 80 MB level pack, fast everywhere
:   object storage + CDN

the live race decides the winner
:   dedicated server
:::
:::

## 22.2 Saves, files and downloads

- **Cloud save:** a few KB per player, at checkpoints; any device after the
  login.
- **Object storage:** files with a web address.
- **CDN:** copies on edge servers near the players.

![Cloud save.](images/cloud-save.png){width=94%}

![A CDN.](images/cdn.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Big level packs inside the app make every update huge.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Find the cloud save"}
Does a game on your phone have a cloud save? What happens to your progress
on a new phone?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Files"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="a printer|a slower phone"}
two devices disagree about the save
:   the newest save wins, or the game asks

where the CDN keeps copies
:   on edge servers near the players

where big, changing content belongs
:   in object storage

what the player needs to load the save
:   the same account
:::
:::

## 22.3 Game servers, regions and safety

- A **dedicated server** decides the match: phones cannot just say "I won".
- **Regions** near most players; more regions only when needed.
- **Secrets stay on the server**, never in the app.

![Latency to three regions (example values).](images/regions.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
The cheapest region far away adds latency to every race.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Choose regions"}
Players in Jordan and Saudi Arabia, 10 % in Germany: which region for the
races? Is a second region worth it?
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · Servers and safety"}
Use the latency table. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="Mumbai|in the app icon"}
the best region for players in Amman and Riyadh
:   Bahrain

the best region for players in Berlin
:   Frankfurt

where the payment key belongs
:   on the server

who measures the race time
:   the dedicated server
:::
:::

## 22.4 What does it cost?

- Use per month × price from the provider's page, for each service.
- **Egress** (downloads) and **server hours** often cost most.
- Save: a CDN, smaller files, servers only when players play, free tiers,
  a budget alarm.

![A monthly cost estimate (example prices).](images/cloud-cost.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/cloud-cost.html" poster="sims/cloud-cost.png" title="Cloud Cost Planner: one month of Pocket Quest" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Prices change: use the current price page and write the date.
:::

:::

Work alone. Use every section of today.

The inbox: a **lost phone**, **slow downloads** in Amman, **jumping cars**
at 90 ms, **impossible race times**, a **secret key** in the app, and a
bill that **doubled**.

{{< sim file="sims/cloud-planner.html" poster="sims/cloud-planner.png" title="Cloud Planner: the right service for each problem" kind="game" height="520" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The inbox"}
Choose what solves it.

::: {.match extra="a bigger icon|more storage"}

:   cloud save

## Summary {.summary}

- A game uses back-end services, storage with a CDN, dedicated servers and
  analytics.
- Cloud saves follow the player; big files go to object storage and a CDN.
- Dedicated servers decide matches; regions near the players lower latency.
- Secrets stay on the server.
- Estimate the cost: downloads and server hours matter most.
